records.title: ELEVATED OVERBRIDGE FOR WILDLIFE MOVEMENT ON NH 127C
details:
The Consultant for preparation of Detailed Project Report 
(DPR) has been engaged to examine the project alignment with reference to the Eco Sensitive 
Zone and requirement of wildlife crossings. Further action, as required, shall be taken based on 
the outcome of the DPR and the applicable statutory requirements.

records.title: ELECTRICITY DEMAND IN NORTH EASTERN REGION
details:
(d): 
In the North Eastern Region (including Assam), six Hydroelectric Power Projects (HEPs), 
with a combined installed capacity of 2,166 MW, are currently under implementation and are 
scheduled to be commissioned on or before 31 December 2030.
